financial_evidence_score_effect: none on momentum results; used only by the separate value_ranking
value_ranking: eligible companies ranked by middle-scenario upside x conviction x risk factors after value-trap exclusions; at most 3 picks, never forced (rules in app/prototype/ranking.py)
same_day_session_completion_boundary: 22:00:00 UTC (conservative; earlier closes are not inferred)
session_calendar: completed dates with a visible US price for at least session_minimum_symbol_share of US symbols priced in the read window
identity_rule: active listing in the completed catalogue visible at the cutoff, exact durable-ID match, one CIK agreed by sec_issuers and classification evidence; full-window listing intervals are not proven
market_cap_formula: latest visible dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding from the retained SEC companyfacts payload (10-K/10-Q cover page; counts in one filing summed) x unadjusted close on the decision session
industry_source: SIC code from the retained SEC submissions payload (sec_liquidity_raw_provenance), visible by retrieval time
excluded_sic_note: finance, insurance, real estate, REITs, holding and investment offices: specialist accounting not yet supported
coverage_extension: a stored coverage record that ends inside the price window is extended to the window end only by a completed EODHD refresh checkpoint (prices and dividends) recorded after 22:00 UTC on the last window session
